HAMZA

Project Type Complete Brand Identity

01 / 09

Project Overview

Establishing a powerful visual presence for a contracting and real estate development company operating across commercial, residential, and general construction sectors.

The primary objective was to craft a distinctive visual identity for HAMZA that reflects its core engineering activity and positions the company with a strong institutional image in front of corporate clients and investors.

Because the company covers commercial developments, residential housing, and general contracting, the identity required a versatile visual language that communicates structural solidity while remaining clean and adaptable across all touchpoints.

Target Audience Corporations & Investors
Business Scope Commercial / Residential / Contracting
Brand Positioning Building Trust, Quality & Future
Deliverables Logo, Guidelines, Print & Social
02 / 09

Challenge & Objectives

How can a new brand communicate structural strength and reliability in an industry built on precision, execution, and strict timelines?

The challenge centered on creating a memorable mark that visually connects the HAMZA name to both high-rise commercial contracting and residential real estate, without relying on cliché or generic construction icons disconnected from the brand name.

Execution Quality

Expressing engineering precision and high attention to architectural detail.

Timely Delivery

Reinforcing the image of a dependable partner that respects project schedules.

Institutional Reliability

Presenting a solid corporate presence that inspires long-term confidence.

03 / 09

Creative Concept

Merging the initial letterform with architectural towers and a residential home symbol into one balanced visual structure.

Core Equation: H + Towers + Home
The letter H transforms into twin architectural towers symbolizing growth and contracting, while the home roof integrated into the letter M represents residential stability.

Through five progressive sketch iterations, we explored the proportion between the structural pillars of the letter H, the perspective lines of the towers, and the house details until arriving at a harmonious, memorable mark.

04 / 09

Logo Development & System

Establishing strict geometric grid proportions (5X / 3X / 2X), clear-space rules, and versatile lockups for every medium.

05 / 09

Visual Identity System

A cohesive visual language across color palettes, Arabic & English typography, custom iconography, and architectural patterns.

Approved Brand Color Palette

Built around engineering blue and structural gray to convey corporate trust and modernity, supported by deep navy, sky blue, and warm architectural sand.

Typography System

Tajawal and Cairo were selected for their geometric clarity, modern terminals, and strong legibility across both large outdoor signage and digital interfaces.

ARABIC TYPEFACE تجوال

Tajawal — Regular / Bold

ENGLISH TYPEFACE Cairo

Cairo — Light / Regular / Bold / Black

06 / 09

Brand Applications & Mockups

Bringing the identity to life across construction site gear, corporate stationery, fleet vehicles, and architectural signage.

07 / 09

Social Media Campaign

A 9-post strategic grid showcasing HAMZA's services, engineering reliability, project milestones, and investment value.

Digital Presence

A Cohesive 9-Post Visual Grid

Balancing dark navy and clean white layouts with diagonal architectural cuts, custom service icons, and real project photography.

09 / 09

Project Outcome

A cohesive visual identity system for HAMZA, combining an ice-mountain geometric mark, a trustworthy blue palette, and versatile packaging and marketing applications.
